title: CCPA & California Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Assess your privacy risk under CCPA. Calculate compliance gaps and get personalized recommendations for California privacy protection.
description: Calculate your privacy risk level under California's CCPA and CPRA laws. Get a personalized risk score based on your data practices, business type, and compliance measures to identify gaps and improve protection.

inputs.label: Business Type
inputs.helpText: CCPA thresholds determine your compliance requirements

inputs.label: Types of Personal Information Collected
inputs.helpText: More sensitive data types increase privacy risk and requirements

inputs.label: Do you sell or share personal information?
inputs.helpText: Data selling triggers additional CCPA obligations

inputs.label: Current Compliance Measures
inputs.helpText: Rate your current privacy policy, opt-out processes, and data handling practices (1=none, 10=comprehensive)

inputs.label: Monthly Consumer Requests
inputs.helpText: Request volume indicates consumer awareness and potential compliance burden

inputs.label: Dedicated Privacy Officer/Team
inputs.helpText: Having dedicated privacy resources reduces compliance risk

outputFields.label: Compliance Grade
outputFields.description: Letter grade based on current compliance status

formula: let riskScore = 20; const businessRisk = {'small': 0, 'medium': 15, 'large': 25, 'data-broker': 35}; riskScore += businessRisk[businessType]; const dataRisk = {'basic': 5, 'identifiers': 15, 'biometric': 25, 'sensitive': 35}; riskScore += dataRisk[dataTypes]; const sellingRisk = {'no': 0, 'advertising': 15, 'commercial': 25, 'extensive': 35}; riskScore += sellingRisk[dataSelling]; riskScore += Math.max(0, 10 - complianceMeasures); const requestRisk = {'none': 0, 'low': 5, 'medium': 10, 'high': 15}; riskScore += requestRisk[requestVolume]; if (!hasPrivacyOfficer && (businessType === 'large' || businessType === 'data-broker')) riskScore += 10; riskScore = Math.min(100, riskScore); let grade = 'F'; if (riskScore <= 30) grade = 'A'; else if (riskScore <= 45) grade = 'B'; else if (riskScore <= 60) grade = 'C'; else if (riskScore <= 75) grade = 'D'; let actions = 0; if (complianceMeasures < 5) actions += 2; if (dataSelling !== 'no' && complianceMeasures < 7) actions += 1; if (!hasPrivacyOfficer && businessType !== 'small') actions += 1; if (requestVolume === 'high' && complianceMeasures < 6) actions += 1; return {riskScore, complianceGrade: grade, priorityActions: actions};

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates privacy risk based on CCPA/CPRA requirements including business size thresholds, data sensitivity levels, selling practices, and current compliance measures. Higher risk scores indicate greater potential for violations and consumer complaints.
tips: Use a privacy-focused browser to research competitor privacy practices without leaving tracking data
Implement a 'Do Not Sell My Personal Information' link prominently on your website

Consider using automated privacy management platforms for high-volume request handling
